sponges text index | photo index Phylum Porifera Thorny stem sponge
Gelliodes fibulata*Family Niphatidaeupdated Oct 2016

Where seen? This sponge that looks like a cluster of thorny thick stems is sometimes seen on growing among living corals. Features: A cluster of a few stems long (10-20cm), sparsely branched, cylindrical covered with small spiny ‘thorns’. Many small holes unevenly scattered over the surface. Colour blue or greenish blue.


Sentosa Serapong, May 12


Kusu Island, Jun 12


Beting Bemban Besar, Jun 09

*Sponge species are difficult to positively identify without close examination.
On this website, they are grouped by external features for convenience of display.
